_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 73 windows moving ±2+ points and transition accuracy at 5.5%, the statistically honest read is that price remains trapped in Denial coiling sideways until a concrete breaker — funding cooling toward 35-40 with price holding $62K+ — emerges.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls UP with low conviction while narrative implies an imminent re-rating; the judge sides with the coil statistics over the directional lean
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds $62K+ with funding dropping below 45 and ETF flows turning positive from -11 toward neutral; DXY breaks below 99.00
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $60K with VIX spiking above 18 and funding rising above 60; or ETF flows dropping below -20 showing sustained institutional exit
